thread:
Maya Chen: quick thought — when users click "Save query" in Console, can we surface an estimated monthly token cost + quota impact in the save modal? would cut down surprise quota spikes. cc @Carlos Ruiz
Carlos Ruiz: we already compute per-route token histograms for billing insights. modal preview could use 30d avg traffic * per-request token estimate * sample_rate. show pessimistic/expected/optimistic bands.
Sophia Lin: ux idea: small inline section under the save CTA with a mini sparkline, a cost badge, and an "impact on quota" line (e.g. "~2% of org quota/month"). make it dismissible for power users.
Oliver Grant: impl note — saved_query needs routing_policy, model_hint, and sample_rate to make the preview meaningful. without persisting those, previews will get stale when routing or sampling changes post-save.
Carlos Ruiz: proposal for saved_query v2 shape (for discussion):
```json
{
  "name": "support",
  "filters": [{"field":"latency_ms","op":">","value":200}],
  "scope": "route",
  "route_id": "r_9a8b",
  "routing_policy": "latency-prefer",
  "model_hint": "redwood/gpt-2-8k",
  "sample_rate": 0.05,
  "telemetry_tags": ["saved_query:sq_123"]
}
```
Maya Chen: include telemetry_tags so we can tie saved queries to evals/regression alerts. also add a tiny audit event when user accepts preview + saves so we can A/B whether previews reduce quota incidents.
Sophia Lin: in modal show a confidence tooltip: "why uncertain" explaining sources of variance (dynamic routing, quantization, variable prompt length). make scenario toggles so users can simulate switching model_hint or routing_policy to see delta.
Oliver Grant: edge cases — for multi-variant routing (canary/fallback) compute weighted expected cost. if weights unknown, either mark uncertain or assume conservative (max). also cache preview results and rate-limit preview endpoints to avoid replay costs.
Carlos Ruiz: api endpoints: POST /api/saved-queries (persist) and POST /api/preview-saved-query -> {estimate_tokens, estimate_cost_usd, quota_delta_percent, confidence}. preview should be cheap and cacheable (10m TTL?)
Maya Chen: UX checkbox debate: should sample_rate be explicit or inherit from route default? my vote: default to inherit in UI but persist explicit value when user toggles it. add a tiny inline explanation so people know when changes to route defaults won't retroactively change saved-query behavior.
Oliver Grant: ops note: previews execute server-side and must obey RBAC and tenant scoping. avoid cross-team leakage and throttle previews per-user. i'll draft perf numbers and suggest caching TTL and cache keys (route_id + routing_policy + model_hint + sample_rate + filter_hash).
Carlos Ruiz: i'll sketch API proto and a migration plan for current saved queries to v2. want to avoid breaking existing savedviews.
deploy-bot: Deploy succeeded: feature/save-query-preview @ staging (build b-521) :rocket:
Sophia Lin: nice. once the API proto is up i can mock the modal and iterate copy for confidence bands + the "simulate change" microflow.
Oliver Grant: will follow up with perf draft and a short checklist for ops (RBAC checks, cache TTLs, rate limits).
